pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Spinbutton pattern on a text <input> with a <label for> association.

roles.role: button (native), not in the tab order

aria.value: Current value; removed when empty or unparseable
Value formatted in the locale (for example 15% or $1,234.50)
Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the input; stepper buttons are skipped.
Increase / decrease by one step (from empty: min, else 0), clamped to [min, max].
Set the minimum / maximum. Without the bound, native caret movement.
Commit: reformat the value and fire aui-change; implicit form submission is not prevented.

focus: The control boundary shows the focus indicator (border in color-focus-ring plus a 1px ring). Pressing a stepper button keeps focus in the input.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by the native required attribute.
Errors appear after the first blur by default so users are not interrupted while typing.
Validation messages format numbers in the locale and style (for example 'Enter a value of 1.000 or more.').
The stepper buttons are a pointer affordance with tabindex -1; every action is available from the keyboard on the input.
Stepper buttons are disabled at the bounds.
knownCaveats: Spinbutton announcements (aria-valuetext on step) have not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
Mobile screen readers expose adjustable spinbutton gestures inconsistently for text inputs.
